candidate.note: Implementation files were produced 2026-11-14/15 and re-verified on 2026-11-24 before landing; no source change was made in this re-verification.

commands.notes: Without a DSN the packages report ok, but the real-MySQL matrix subtests SKIP ('mysql test dsn is not configured'). Recorded to justify running the DSN-bound form below.

PANTHEON_TEST_DSN_REQUIRED=true with an isolated real MySQL DSN: all three packages ok under -race (auth/login 230.278s, exercising the capability, fresh-scope, owner/role/key/policy revocation, unregistered action, unavailable-store and cancellation matrix).
Whole backend builds with the new contracts and auth adapter in place.
Cross-check that the revocation matrix is genuinely DSN-gated: without PANTHEON_TEST_DSN every subtest reports SKIP, so a skip is never mistaken for a pass.

historicalEvidence.notes: Failed-before witness: the auth-owned reader had no durable job authorization capability (ErrBusinessProviders).

Green -json run of the three packages against isolated real MySQL: capability availability, fresh scope without session, current-owner revocation matrix, unregistered/ambiguous action rejection, unavailable-store and cancellation denials.

knownGaps: Independent review is still open; .harness/evidence/.../review.md is a coordinator verification record, not the independent gate.
Official foundation publication and downstream Ops consumption have not been performed.
The historical green log carries the TSan/TSan-infra allocation note from the original run; the 2026-11-24 re-run above is a clean -race pass on the current tree.
